window.title: Skathi devtools
window.$comment-minWidth: 480, not the 720 this UI is comfortable at: Windows 11 snap layouts reject a window whose minimum width exceeds ~500 epx, and a devtools window is one you want to snap beside the app it is inspecting. The host advises when the ceiling is crossed — that advisory is how this number was chosen.
window.$comment-titleBarFallback: false: the inspector paints its own titlebar on the first frame, and the host's fallback strip would appear for exactly one frame before retiring — a visible flash in the one app whose job is to look at other apps carefully.
